title: Brand and Marketing Manager
description:
Are you a creative, commercially minded marketer who knows how to build a brilliant brand, bring it to life through compelling content and turn great ideas into genuine business opportunities? Someone who's just as comfortable shaping strategy as getting stuck into creating content, delivering campaigns and generating leads? If so, this could be a fantastic opportunity to build a marketing function from scratch and play a key role in the growth of an ambitious business.

The Company

Our client is a hugely successful and growing food business supplying customers across the UK. If you haven't eaten one of their products in the last couple of weeks, there's a pretty good chance the person next to you has.

With ambitious expansion plans, exciting product innovation and growing retail ambitions, the business is looking to build a nationally recognised brand. New partnerships and collaborations are opening up, making this a fantastic time to join and shape its marketing function from the ground up.

The Role - Brand and Marketing Manager

This is a fantastic opportunity for a creative, commercially minded marketer who wants to do more than deliver someone else's marketing plan.

Working with the leadership team, you'll shape the brand and marketing strategy, create compelling content and deliver targeted campaigns that generate enquiries from national foodservice operators, wholesalers, restaurant groups and retailers. You'll also help bring product launches, chef demonstrations and new collaborations to life, turning ideas into qualified sales opportunities.

It's a rare combination of strategic influence and hands-on creativity, with a genuine voice in the company's growth and the opportunity to build something that has your fingerprints all over it.

Key Responsibilities - Brand and Marketing Manager
- Develop and deliver a marketing strategy that supports the company's ambitious growth plans.
- Take ownership of the brand, ensuring a consistent, compelling identity and tone of voice across all channels.
- Personally create engaging content across social media, digital platforms and marketing materials, including photography, filming, editing and writing.
- Build the company's social media presence, particularly across LinkedIn and Instagram, developing audiences and encouraging meaningful engagement.
- Work closely with the leadership, product development and chef teams to organise product launches, coordinate chef demonstrations and bring new products and innovations to market.
- Help shape and promote exciting new partnerships and collaborations, identifying opportunities to extend the brand's reach.
- Develop targeted campaigns that generate qualified enquiries and sales opportunities from national foodservice operators, wholesalers, restaurant groups and retailers.
- Plan and deliver email marketing campaigns, using CRM data to segment audiences, nurture relationships and support customer engagement.
- Use CRM systems to track campaign responses and enquiries, support timely sales follow-up and measure how marketing activity contributes to qualified opportunities.
- Produce engaging sales and marketing materials, from product presentations and email campaigns to customer stories and website content.
- Establish marketing processes, manage budgets and measure performance, continually refining activity to deliver the best results.

About You - Brand and Marketing Manager

We're looking for someone who can see the bigger picture but is equally happy picking up a camera, writing a great piece of copy or getting stuck into a campaign.

You'll be comfortable developing ideas, challenging thinking and turning a relatively blank marketing canvas into something rather impressive.

Ideally, you'll bring:
- Broad marketing experience, with the confidence to take ownership of both strategy and delivery.
- A genuine flair for content creation, storytelling and brand development.
- Strong writing skills and an eye for engaging photography, video and visual content, with the ability to produce and edit content personally rather than relying entirely on agencies.
- Experience building social media audiences and creating campaigns that deliver meaningful engagement.
- Experience using CRM systems and delivering effective email marketing campaigns, with an understanding of audience segmentation and customer engagement.
- A commercial mindset and experience turning targeted marketing activity into relevant enquiries and qualified sales opportunities.
- The confidence to work closely with senior stakeholders, chefs and commercial teams, contributing to discussions around innovation, retail growth, partnerships and new opportunities.
- A proactive, resourceful approach, with the ability to establish processes and make things happen without needing a fully formed marketing department around you.

Experience within food, FMCG, hospitality or another product-led business would be advantageous, although we're equally interested in people from other sectors who can demonstrate the right combination of creativity, commercial thinking and initiative.

title: Communications and Engagement Manager
description:
Communications and Engagement Manager Future Projects

Location: Norwich, with occasional Norfolk-wide travel
Hours: 37 hours per week (subject to the Four Day Week scheme following 6 months in post)
Salary: £35,000 to £38,000 pa (depending on experience)
Leave: 25 days per annum plus Bank Holidays
Application Deadline: Monday 14th December 2026

Interviews: Week commencing Monday 21st December 2026
Reports to: Head of Funding, Partnerships and Impact

About the Role

Future Projects is a Norwich charity, founded in 2000, helping people in difficult situations build the skills, confidence and resilience to take control and transform their lives. We provide practical support across food and essentials, advice and guidance, health and wellbeing, employment, education and community connection.

As Communications and Engagement Manager, you will lead how Future Projects is seen, heard and understood. In this strategic role across the whole charity, you will strengthen our brand, voice and visibility, help Future Radio grow its profile, and make sure communities help shape our services and the story of our impact.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead the rollout of our brand, verbal identity and key messages, turning them into guidance, templates and training for staff.
- Develop and deliver a communications and marketing plan linked to the charity s strategy.
- Oversee website content, social media, newsletters, press, printed materials and campaigns.
- Work with the Future Radio team to promote the station and use radio, podcasts and digital content to support community voice.
- Develop community engagement and feedback approaches so people help shape our services and communications.
- Turn outcomes, data and case studies into impact stories that support fundraising and partnerships, with strict GDPR-compliant consent.

About You
- Strong experience in communications, marketing, media, engagement or brand.
- Excellent writing and editing skills for different audiences and channels.
- Experience developing communications plans, campaigns, content and brand assets.
- Strong understanding of digital communications, websites, social media and accessibility.
- Sound judgement around consent, GDPR, safeguarding and sensitive stories.
- Confident supporting and training colleagues, and building relationships with leaders, partners, funders and media.
- Desirable: charity or social impact sector experience, and an understanding of community media, radio, podcasting or video.

How to Apply
- Apply through this advert to receive an application form, along with the full job description.
- Complete the form in full, using the person specification and key deliverables to structure your answers. CVs are not accepted without a completed application form.

Additional Information
- Office and service-site working, with some flexibility around campaigns, events and launches.
- May line manage communications staff if such roles are created.
- Induction and training provided, including Health and Safety and Safeguarding.
- Appointment subject to pre-employment checks, including right to work, two references and an appropriate DBS check.
- Future Projects is an equal opportunities, Living Wage and Disability Confident employer.

title: Communications Assistant
description:
Communications Assistant
- Job Type: Full-time, fixed-term contract until 31 March 2028
- Location: Norwich
- Salary: £25,100 - £27,500 per annum

We are looking for a Communications Assistant to join a busy Communications Team. This is a broad, hands-on opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to develop skills across media relations, digital content, events and public engagement. The Communications Assistant will help raise the profile of scientific work with public, media, scientific, policy and internal audiences.

Day-to-day of the role
- Support the delivery of communications activity across a range of channels and audiences
- Write and edit engaging content for the website, social media and internal communications
- Assist with media relations activity and help identify opportunities to promote research stories
- Support the planning and delivery of open days, public events and engagement activity
- Work closely with internal teams to gather information and turn complex science into accessible content
- Help schedule digital content and monitor engagement across communication channels
- Provide strong administrative and organisational support across communications projects
- Contribute ideas that help increase awareness of research, events and wider organisational activity
- Support occasional events outside normal working hours when required

Required Skills & Qualifications
- Some experience in communications or a related area, including internships, volunteering or student roles
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail
- Confidence using social media and creating clear, engaging content
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a varied workload
- A genuine interest in science communication and research-led environments
- Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and communicate with a range of audiences
- A proactive attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn and develop professionally
- Flexibility to support occasional evening or out-of-hours events

Benefits
- Opportunity to gain broad experience across media, digital content, events and public engagement
- Varied Communications Assistant role within an exciting scientific research setting
- Supportive environment for learning, development and career growth
- Inclusive employer committed to offering interviews to disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria
- Full-time contract providing stability through to March 2028
- Salary offered in line with qualifications and experience

Please apply with your updated CV.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive
Full-time, hybrid working (three days in the office, two from home)
King's Lynn
We are looking for an ambitious, creative and data-driven Digital Marketing Executive and thisis an exciting opportunity to play a key role in growing the digital presence of an established, award-winning British manufacturer. You will be responsible for helping to increase visibility across Google and social media, driving relevant traffic to their website and, most importantly, generating high-quality enquiries for their sales team.

The role combines SEO, Google Ads, content creation, social media and digital performance analysis, making it ideal for someone who enjoys both the creative and analytical sides of digital marketing.

You will have the opportunity to influence their digital marketing strategy, develop engaging content showcasing our products and customer projects, and make a measurable contribution to the growth of the business.

Key Responsibilities:
SEO & Website Performance
- Develop and implement effective SEO strategies to improve organic search rankings, traffic and lead generation.
- Conduct keyword research to identify opportunities for commercially relevant content.
- Create and optimise website content, including landing pages, blogs, buying guides and customer case studies.
- Monitor keyword rankings, website traffic, user behaviour and conversion performance.
- Identify and implement technical and on-page SEO improvements.
- Develop engaging content around product design, planning permission, customer projects and industry trends.
- Support backlink acquisition, digital PR and other activities to strengthen their website's authority.
- Improve local search visibility and optimise Google Business Profiles.

Google Ads & Paid Digital Marketing
- Assist with the management and optimisation of Google Ads campaigns, including Search and Performance Max.
- Analyse campaign performance, search terms, keywords, audiences and conversion data to identify opportunities for improvement.
- Support the development of new campaigns, advertising copy and landing pages.
- Monitor advertising spend, cost per enquiry and return on investment.
- Work to improve both the volume and quality of enquiries generated through paid advertising.

Social Media & Content Creation
- Help plan, create and deliver engaging content across our social media channels, including Instagram, Facebook and other relevant platforms.
- Create compelling short-form video content, including Instagram and Facebook Reels, showcasing our buildings, customer installations, craftsmanship and behind-the-scenes activities.
- Work with colleagues to capture photography and video content at our factory, show centres and customer locations.
- Develop creative content ideas that communicate the quality, design and benefits of our products.
- Write engaging social media copy that reflects our premium brand positioning.
- Monitor social media engagement and performance, identifying opportunities to improve reach, website visits and enquiries.

Data Analysis & Marketing Performance
- Use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console and other digital marketing tools to monitor and evaluate performance.
- Establish, monitor and report against clear marketing KPIs, including traffic quality, conversion rates, cost per lead and enquiry volumes.
- Analyse customer journeys and website behaviour to identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.
- Produce regular, insightful performance reports, highlighting trends, opportunities and recommended actions.
- Work closely with the sales and design teams to understand customer behaviour, identify content opportunities and improve lead quality.
- Continuously test and refine digital marketing activity to improve results and maximise return on investment.

About You
You will be commercially minded and understand that successful digital marketing is not simply about attracting more visitors or gaining social media followers, but about generating quality enquiries that convert into sales. Please get in touch today to find out more about this excellent opportunity!

title: Marketing Brand Manager

description:

EXPERIENCE & REQUIREMENTS

title: SEO Executive
description:

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Are you a creative and commercially minded social media professional looking to make your mark within a fast-growing British lifestyle brand?

Our client is seeking an experienced Social Media Manager to lead and develop their social media presence across multiple platforms. This is an exciting opportunity to shape brand storytelling, drive engagement, grow online communities, and lead a talented social media team within a dynamic and ambitious business.

Reporting directly to the Head of Brand, you will be responsible for developing and executing the organic social media strategy, ensuring content is engaging, authentic, and aligned with the brand's vision.
- Develop and execute the social media strategy across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and emerging platforms.
- Manage the content calendar, ensuring a balance of campaigns, product launches, brand storytelling, and reactive content.
- Drive audience growth, engagement, brand awareness, and website traffic.
- Maintain consistent brand messaging and visual identity across all platforms.
- Identify new opportunities to expand reach and attract new audiences.
- Create engaging social-first content including short-form video, photography, and written copy.
- Develop creative concepts, campaign briefs, and mood boards.
- Attend events, launches, and brand activations to capture content and tell compelling stories.
- Explore innovative content formats including live shopping, founder-led content, and emerging social trends.
- Work closely with Digital teams to support paid social campaigns and promotions.
- Partner with PR teams on influencer activity and campaign execution.
- Manage, mentor, and develop the Social Media Assistant and Social Media Intern.
- Oversee daily community management, ensuring timely and engaging responses.
- Collaborate with customer-facing teams to resolve enquiries and share customer feedback insights.
- Foster a creative, high-performing team culture.
- Monitor and report on key performance metrics including reach, engagement, audience growth, and website traffic.
- Analyse trends, competitor activity, and audience behaviour.
- Use insights to optimise future content and campaign performance.
- Develop structured testing plans to continuously improve results.

About You

We're looking for a social media specialist who can combine creativity with commercial thinking. You will ideally have:
- Proven social media management experience within a fashion, lifestyle, retail, or consumer brand.
- Demonstrable success growing and engaging online communities.
- Strong content creation skills across video, photography, and copywriting.
- Experience managing or mentoring team members.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- Strong understanding of social media analytics and reporting.
- Knowledge of how organic social, paid activity, influencer marketing, and PR work together to drive results.
- Experience using social scheduling, reporting, and analytics platforms.

What's on Offer?
- The opportunity to join a growing and highly regarded British lifestyle brand.
- A chance to shape and influence the brand's social media presence and strategy.
- Exposure to exciting campaigns, events, content shoots, and brand experiences.
- Leadership responsibility with the opportunity to develop and grow a social media team.
